# qddate

Python library for parsing left-aligned date strings extracted from messy HTML as fast as possible. Runtime depends on pyparsing only. Public API: `qddate.DateParser` with `parse()` and `match()`.

Site: https://ivbeg.github.io/qddate/
Install: `pip install qddate`
